citation: NCHS, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2013-2014: Blood Pressure (BPX_H), Standard Biochemistry Profile (BIOPRO_H), Demographics (DEMO_H). Work of the United States government, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); no data-use agreement.
weighting: point estimates unweighted; design-weighted naive LS and corrected LS reported in diagnostics.csv as a check

bootstrap.kind: stratified cluster bootstrap over PSUs within strata
bootstrap.propagates: reading-number adjustment, moment recovery nu_2..nu_6, cumulant deconvolution, weight optimisation and all five fits

gates.name: R0 file checksums
gates.detail: BPX_H.xpt: match; BIOPRO_H.xpt: match; DEMO_H.xpt: match

gates.name: R1 replicate system vs theory/replicate_identification.py
gates.detail: symbolic identity of E[d^p] for p = 2,3,4,5: p=2: ok, p=3: ok, p=4: ok, p=5: ok; p=6 is the extension needed for nu_6, coefficient 0.090535

gates.name: R2 all six moments identified at k = 3
gates.detail: coefficients of nu_p in E[d^p]: 2: 0.6667, 3: 0.2222, 4: 0.2222, 5: 0.1235, 6: 0.0905 (every one non-zero, so nu_2..nu_6 are all identified; at k = 2 the coefficients of nu_3 and nu_5 are exactly zero)

gates.name: R3 TC-PMM2* weight fallback never fired
R6 bootstrap convergence
gates.detail: all 2000 resamples converged for all 5 estimators

gates.name: R8 measurement error independent of the covariate
gates.detail: the pair variance (W_2-W_3)^2/2 has slope -0.3887 (SE 0.0820, t = -4.74) on reading 1; nu_2 falls from 25.7 to 13.0 across reading-1 quintiles. Reading 1 is independent of the errors in readings 2 and 3, so this is not a mechanical artefact

gates.name: R9 regression error independent of the covariate
gates.detail: the squared naive residual has slope +0.00345 (t = 3.30) on the surrogate; the cubed residual t = 0.58. Least squares tolerates this; the quadratic moment condition of the degree-two score does not

gates.name: R7 corrected LS and TC-PMM2* agree on the slope
gates.detail: difference 0.001458 with cluster-bootstrap SE 0.000349, z = 4.18. Under the model of this paper both are consistent for beta_1, so a large z is a specification signal, not an efficiency result. It is reported, not suppressed.

gates.name: R10 the transplanted weight never loses at this shape of U
gates.detail: closed-form efficiency of the transplanted weight over lambda in [0.50, 0.995] with the standardised shape of U and the regression-error moments held at their estimates: maximum 0.8964, attained at lambda = 0.500. With beta_1 nu_3 < 0 no break-even reliability exists, so this dataset lies in the benign part of the parameter space, not the adversarial part

attrition.note: blood-pressure examination file, one row per subject
a recorded 0 means no fifth Korotkoff sound was heard; it is not a measurement of diastolic pressure and is dropped
